definition: Number of full-suite runs passing when host CPU is saturated by 8 concurrent busy loops

evidence: VERBATIM ERROR: 'Test timed out in 5000ms.' at src/lib/android-native-bridge.dom.test.ts:59-60
exact_test: applyAndroidInsets > falls back to CSS env() insets when no native bridge exists
cause: CPU contention. The test has a 5000ms default timeout and performs a dynamic import plus work that starves under parallel-worker CPU pressure. NOT caused by the retry logic under test.
introduced_by: Suite SIZE, not code. fix/http-retry-policy adds 112 tests (734->846), increasing parallel worker contention enough to push this pre-existing test past its 5s limit.
is_pre_existing: Yes - the test itself is unmodified and passes on 7111ff9 even under identical load
confidence: high - failure deliberately reproduced by loading 8 CPUs, and did not reproduce in 10 consecutive unloaded runs
limitations: Did not measure on real mobile hardware or under CI runner contention. Vitest worker count and default timeout not reconfigured during baseline.
risk: Flaky suites destroy trust in CI and mask real regressions. A 1-in-2 failure rate under load is unacceptable for a release gate.
priority_reason: Not a product defect and not security, but a suite that fails under load cannot gate a release
acceptance: Test passes N=20 consecutive full-suite runs under the same 8-CPU load, OR the test gets an explicit timeout/scoped worker budget with justification
remeasurement: Re-run the same saturated-load protocol after the fix
